bug_1_exp14_dataset_truncation.finding: In EXP-14 run_experiment.py line 290, rendering was capped with 'and idx < 1000', resulting in only the first ~300 sparse samples being rendered. All subsequent 7,910 rows received delta_num_links=0 and fallback static features.
bug_1_exp14_dataset_truncation.impact: Over 88% of dataset samples had zero rendered deltas in the cached dataset.

bug_2_exp15_candidate_score_bypass.finding: In EXP-15 run_experiment.py lines 324-328 (Candidates B, C, D, E, G), the code evaluated s1 (static score) and applied a heuristic rule: 'if delta_links >= 10 and strong_veto == 0: prob = 0.30 else: s1 >= 0.50'.
bug_2_exp15_candidate_score_bypass.impact: The production model XGBoost predict_proba() was NEVER called with the 43-feature rendered vector! The candidates only checked delta_links on a truncated dataset and manually forced score=0.30.

bug_3_cascade_meta_feature_isolation.finding: In EXP-15 Candidate F, a separate Stage 2 LogisticRegression model was trained on 5 meta-features (stage1_score, delta_num_links, delta_num_internal_links, strong_phishing_evidence_score, is_spa_shell_pattern) rather than passing the full 43 rendered features through the production classifier.
bug_3_cascade_meta_feature_isolation.impact: The full 43-feature rendered representation was completely isolated and never evaluated against the production XGBoost model.
